comment: Great base for a festival weekend in Detroit. Quiet, well-equipped, walking distance to the riverfront stages.
Perfect beach getaway with the kids. Steps from the sand and the kitchen was well stocked.
Marcus is a wonderful host. The loft was immaculate and close to the jazz clubs and great coffee.
Clean and quiet, easy streetcar access. Perfect for a solo trip on the festival circuit.
The porch is a gem. Coffee with an ocean view before heading out for the day.
Lovely townhouse a block from the beach. Great for a long weekend away from the city.
Comfortable room in Hyde Park, very peaceful. The host gave excellent neighborhood restaurant tips.
